unsupported.step: For an exported root theme, install the Studio registry item, keep ultima-theme.json and review DESIGN.md before replacement. Run npx ultima-design doctor and npx ultima-design check, then check the root, a control and an open popup in dark, light and system mode, including reduced motion and loaded fonts.
